title: Tesla's Cybercab drives itself so owners can earn without driving

Tesla's Cybercab goes on sale soon and the inside looks like nothing before it
caption:
Tesla's Cybercab has no steering wheel, no pedals, and no driver. It goes on sale September 3.

This is Tesla's first fully autonomous taxi. You get in, tell it where to go, and it handles everything from there. No human involved at any point. Tesla's pitch to buyers is that you can send your Cybercab out as a robotaxi when you're not using it, letting the car earn money on its own while you do something else.
